items.title: Richard Wyands interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 7, 2002
items.q: a friend of mine by the name of Wyatt Bull Ruther, he’s a bass player, he was living near Ottawa, Ontario, Canada. He had a little gig in a jazz club. And he asked me if I wanted to come out there and join him.

ctx.x: So you finally decided to come to New York, was it a conscious decision or did it just kind of—

Well I had been thinking about it. In 1954 I was still working at the Blackhawk. It was like a steady gig. And I was able to take a vacation and come back to the job. That’s how nice these owners were at the Blackhawk. They liked me that much. So I decided I would take a trip east. So I went to Chicago and then I went to New York, stayed a week, came back to Chicago, went to all the clubs in Chicago. And then I thought to myself well I don’t think I’m ready yet for New York.
